Third-party libraries, bundled here so the site has no external dependencies:

- `firebase.js` — Firebase JS SDK 12.19.0 (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk), bundled with esbuild (only the Auth + Firestore functions the app uses).
- `jspdf.umd.min.js` — jsPDF 2.5.2 (MIT, see jspdf.LICENSE)
- `jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js` — jsPDF-AutoTable 3.8.4 (MIT, see jspdf-autotable.LICENSE)
